bullets.title: Bounce holding
bullets.text: December gold futures were near 3,620 at about 14:40 SAST, up about 3% on the day; the exact spot price at this hour is UNVERIFIED, last confirmed near 3,625 at 09:43 SAST.

bullets.title: Ceiling not broken
bullets.text: Today's high so far is about 3,629-3,641, so price is still stuck under the 3,630-3,650 zone.

bullets.title: Hike bets still high
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 93-96% odds of a December hike (sources differ), a little lower than last week's near 100%.

bullets.title: Dollar mixed
bullets.text: The dollar index was near 103.6-103.7 this morning and bounced after weak Eurozone and UK PMI data (latest level UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Yields under 5%
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield is near 4.9%, down from about 5.05-5.07% midweek, which is helping gold bounce.

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold lost about 9% last week and touched about 3,503, so one strong day has not changed the bigger downtrend yet.

bullets.title: PMI tonight
bullets.text: US flash PMI is at 16:45 SAST, about an hour after this update, so expect fast moves around then.
